thread:
Jules M: Noticed a handful of customers billed at the new experiment price even though they're in the legacy-preserve cohort. Saw it in the daily exceptions.
Arun P: Can you paste one invoice id? I'll pull the billing timeline.
Jules M: invoice 2026-04-02-DELTA-501. Charged 0.06/token vs expected 0.042.
Tessa H: Hmm — our rate selection service reads 'preserve_legacy' flag from account metadata and from the v1->v2 backfill. We shipped a backfill last night. Could be race with Stripe webhook processing.
Carlos G: stripe-bot: webhook-delivery 2026-04-02T03:12:10Z status=200 id=evt_3KkEwH9g
Arun P: Looking at logs: at 03:11 account meta updated (preserve_legacy=false) then at 03:12 Stripe posted usage event which our billing worker consumed and used the updated flag. Backfill job may have overwritten correctly-tagged accounts.
Jules M: Blast radius?
Arun P: Quick query: `select customer_id from billing_events where event_time between '2026-04-02T02:00' and '2026-04-02T05:00' and rate_applied > expected_rate;` returns 18 rows so far.
Tessa H: Action: pause backfill, revert the merge step, and re-run reconcile for that window. I'll open a PR to stop the backfill immediately.
Carlos G: stripe-bot: payout-hold triggered for 18 accounts pending review.
Jules M: Finance: are we ok to auto-issue credits for confirmed mischarges? Need policy.
Tessa H: I recommend hold-off on auto credits until we confirm full list. We'll prepare a templated credit note.
Arun P: I'll run a dry reconciliation and produce CSV by EOD. Also will tag each affected invoice with label `suspected-rate-mismatch`.
Jules M: Can we revert charges in Stripe or issue invoice adjustment?
Carlos G: Stripe supports invoice credit notes. But for usage-based charges we usually do post-pay credits. We'll coordinate with payments team.
Jules M: Draft customer comms if >10: short apology, note correction, timeline for credit. I'll draft.
Tessa H: Root cause: backfill job used asynchronous worker pool without ordering guarantee. Fix: add versioned tag writes and write-intent lock. Hotfix scheduled.
Arun P: Hotfix PR #8427 created, canary deploy in 10m at 1929992800. After canary, run reconcile for 00:00-06:00 UTC.
billing-bot: Reconcile summary (pre-hotfix): accounts_flagged=18 total_estimated_credit=$2,140 avg_credit=$119
stripe-bot: support-ticket #BILL-772 open with Stripe: "clarify webhook ordering for retry deliveries"
Jules M: Great. Keep this thread for status. If final affected >25 we'll do outbound comms.
Tessa H: Also adding metric alert to catch rate mismatches >5 in 1h.
Arun P: CSV export done and uploaded to /secure/finance/exports/legacy_preserve_1929991234.csv. DMing finance.
Jules M: Thanks all. Moving to postmortem template after this is closed. :pray:
